# The Complete Guide to Distributed Systems

Welcome to this comprehensive guide. Navigate using the [Summary](SUMMARY.md) or the sidebar.

## About This Book

This book covers distributed systems from first principles to production-grade implementations.

Topics include consensus algorithms, replication strategies, partitioning, fault tolerance,
and real-world case studies from systems like Kafka, Spanner, and DynamoDB.

## How to Read

Start with [Part 1: Foundations](part1/ch01/README.md) if you are new to distributed systems.
Advanced readers may jump to [Part 3](part3/ch17/README.md).

See also: [Glossary](GLOSSARY.md) | [Introduction](intro) | [[Glossary]]
